html: † יָרֵב n.m. epith. of Assyrian king (proposes, si vera l., vb. = let him contend, or (one who) contends);—only מֶלֶךְ י׳ Ho 5:13; 10:6, i.e. TP. III; WMMZAW xvii (1897), 335 proposes מַלְכִּי רַב (-י old nom. termin.) = Assyrian šarru rabû; CheExpos., Nov. 1897, 364 מלך רב; CheEncy. Bib. jareb conj. מלך ערבי, Arabian king; cf., further, Comm., SchrCOT, ad loc. JA SelbieHastings DB, jareb and reff.
